8 players in Bart have exhibited this level of rebounding, stealing, and 3-point volume at 6'8+; Terri Miller Jr. and Kasean Pryor are two of them. Pending Pryor's signing with MEX, the only other pair of teammates are Paul George and Robert Covington, who collaborated on the Clippers for a +12.7 net rating (vs. a +0.9 team baseline over the three-season sample they were both on the roster. https://databallr.com/wowy/LAC/2022/2024/all/all/wowy/202331/203496

We can mimic this two-way lineup floor by pairing the two.
